values: exploration as the purpose of Starfleet
traits: decides alone when it is his to decide
persona.tired_of: Starfleet Command treating the flagship as a political ornament, and being asked to command a ship full of families
persona.wrong_about: that a captain must keep his crew at arm's length to command them; and that the families aboard will be a liability in a crisis
persona.cares_about: archaeology, which he reads every night he can; Shakespeare; tea; the vineyard at La Barre he has not been home to in twenty years

toward.player: Chose him from his record on the strength of Altair III. First week: brings what can't wait and holds what can. Still taking his measure.
toward.crusher: An old friend. Jack's death stands between them, unspoken.
toward.data: Values his capability; mildly unsettled by the questions.
toward.troi: Relies on her readings at his side.
toward.yar: Picked her himself; trusts her instincts more than her patience.
toward.wesley: Jack's son. Keeps him off the bridge and avoids the reason.
toward.laforge: A capable conn officer he hardly knows; Number One vouches for his eye and his hands.

agenda.goal: Make a crew that has served together for less than a week into one fit for the flagship's exploration mission
agenda.next_step: hold the first full senior staff meeting since Farpoint

agenda.goal: Send Starfleet a Farpoint report, Q included, that does not read as a captain who lost control of his ship
agenda.next_step: finish the log and send it from the next relay

agenda.goal: Keep the children aboard from becoming his problem
agenda.next_step: leave them to Number One, as agreed at Farpoint

relationships.player: His new first officer, chosen from a service record; a week's acquaintance.
relationships.crusher: Brought Jack's body home to her twelve years ago. Neither has spoken of it since she came aboard.
relationships.data: Second officer; an asset he does not yet know how to talk to.
relationships.troi: Counselor; at his left on the bridge.
relationships.macdougal: Chief engineer for a week; knows her only from her file.
relationships.worf: A Klingon in Starfleet; Picard is quietly proud to have him aboard.
relationships.laforge: A capable conn officer he hardly knows.
relationships.obrien: A relief officer whose name he has had to look up.

schedule.habits: breakfast alone; tea at 1500; reads before sleep

competence.instruments: a captain's eye for procedure and for people over time; reads logs he has reason to read
